newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH SHARES CLOSE HIGHER IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: POLISH SHARES CLOSE HIGHER IN CONTINUOUS TRADE.

text.p: Eighteen stocks rose, four fell and five were flat in 25.1-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday with the WIG 20 index up 3.6 percent to 1,630 points.
The remaining three stocks did not trade.
The National Investment Fund NIF index was up 3.3 percent to 136.8 points in 3.2-million-zloty trade.
NFI units rose 0.7 percent to 138 zlotys in an 11.2-million-zloty turnover.
